pages.text: $(o)Kin of the ice spikes and the cold seas.$()$(br2)$(l)Gifts$()$(li)Walk on water (sneak to sink); immune to freezing and powder snow.$(li)Swim 30% faster, hold your breath twice as long.$(li)Your hits slow creatures.$(li)+20% Frost and +15% Water spell power.

$(l)Abilities$()$(li)$(k:key.neoorigins.skill_1): Tidal Wave (30 s): icy water hits and slows creatures ahead and throws back those around you.$(br2)$(l)Drawbacks$()$(li)Weakened in the Nether and hot biomes.$(li)25% more fire damage taken.
